title: Phase III Acute Coronary Syndrome
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine if apixaban is superior to placebo for preventing cardiovascular death, non-fatal myocardial infarction, or ischemic stroke in subjects with a recent acute coronary syndrome
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Acute coronary syndrome (ACS)
* Clinically stable
* Receiving standard of care for ACS

Exclusion Criteria:

* Severe hypertension
* Active bleeding or high risk for major bleeding
* Hemoglobin \< 9 g/dL
